notes: The XTP II CrossPoint 3200 is a modular, empty matrix-switcher ENCLOSURE (frame), not a fixed-I/O device: it has 8 input card slots and 8 output card slots that accept separately-purchased XTP II input/output boards (HDMI, DVI, 3G-SDI, 12G-SDI, RGBHV/analog, XTP twisted-pair, XTP fiber, etc.). The ports listed above are only the connectors fixed to the enclosure itself (control, network, power) per the authoritative Extron spec sheet (doc 5632-D3, "XTP II CrossPoint 3200 Enclosure"). Actual video/audio I/O (type, count, and bandwidth grade such as HDMI 2.0 or 12G-SDI) depends entirely on which input/output cards are installed and cannot be assigned to the base model. Two power-inlet variants exist depending on SKU: 60-1546-01 (IEC C14 inlet, 100-240VAC) and 60-1981-01 (IEC C20 inlet, region-dependent higher-current input). Both are sold with a standard "Everlast" redundant power supply; the spec sheet text confirms redundancy but the fetched text did not explicitly show a rear-panel diagram enumerating two separate inlet receptacles, so the second AC-in port is a reasonable inference from "redundant power supply is standard," not a directly confirmed rear-panel photo/diagram — flagged as medium confidence. The USB control port is physically a mini USB-B connector; "usb-micro" was chosen as the closest available id in the allowed connector list since "usb mini-b" is not an option (also note mini-B is a low-speed USB 2.0 port, not a high-speed data link, so no grade was set). No HDMI/SDI/DVI ports appear on the base enclosure - do not conflate this model with the older non-"II" XTP CrossPoint 3200 or its enclosure/board combo spec PDF, which share very similar model numbers and documentation URLs.

ports.name: Remote (RS-232/RS-422)
ports.note: Rear panel female 9-pin D connector; bidirectional RS-232 or RS-422 selectable, 9600-115200 baud

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Front panel female mini USB-B control port, USB 2.0 low speed. Closest listed connector id used; actual connector is mini USB-B, not micro.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Female RJ-45, 10/100Base-T half/full duplex with autodetect

ports.name: AC In (Power Supply 1)
ports.note: Model 60-1546-01: IEC 60320 C14 inlet, 100-240 VAC 50-60 Hz. Model 60-1981-01 variant uses a C20 inlet instead (see notes).

ports.name: AC In (Power Supply 2)
ports.note: Redundant Everlast power supply is standard on this chassis; spec sheet confirms dual/redundant PSU but does not explicitly enumerate a second rear-panel inlet diagram, so this second inlet is inferred from 'redundant power supply is standard' language.
